name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 3 – Am 83
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 3a. Strongly believes that strengthening Europe’s security and defence requires not just a simple increase in ambition and action, but a complete overhaul of the way we act and invest in our security and defence, such that from now on we plan, innovate, develop, purchase, maintain and deploy capabilities together, in a coordinated and integrated fashion, and making full use of the complementary competences of all actors in Europe, including NATO, to achieve a common European defence;
